display.purpose: Architectural hero wordmark and major campaign statements.

body.purpose: Navigation, product detail, controls, and 18px supporting copy.

motion.name: hero-arrival
motion.purpose: Introduce the hero image and type as one measured campaign reveal.

motion.name: product-hover
motion.purpose: Give product media a small, deliberate zoom response.

motion.name: campaign-scroll-film
motion.value: 30-frame WebP sprites stepped by a native CSS view timeline over each 175vh scene
motion.purpose: Scrub original campaign motion and scene copy into a three-movement journal without a JavaScript scroll listener; retain poster fallbacks and matching 30fps GIF previews.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Keep all content and controls immediately available.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: A deep-ink conversion action used on light surfaces and the product dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 51px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid #000d10; border-radius: 1000px; background: #000d10; color: #ffffff; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Nova, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #bc7155; border-color: #bc7155; }

components.name: Quiet Pill Button
components.description: A secondary action with a white field and ink hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 51px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid #000d10; border-radius: 1000px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.56); color: #000d10; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Nova, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: #bc7155; border-color: #bc7155; }

components.name: Collection Filter
components.description: A compact, full-pill category control for a small catalog.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #d5d3d4; border-radius: 1000px; background: #ffffff; color: #000d10; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Nova, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #000d10; border-color: #000d10; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: A white-on-midnight email field paired with a direct join action.
components.css: .ds-email { min-height: 54px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.48); border-radius: 1000px; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Nova, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bc7155; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: A sticky white navigation line with a single dark bag action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,13,16,.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,.88); color: #000d10; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Nova, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #000d10; border-radius: 1000px; background: #000d10; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Northline is a light, image-led utility storefront. It uses a pale dawn sky, oversized deep-ink typography, a white editorial canvas, dark terminal sections, one clay feature block, and a three-movement scroll film to make practical clothing feel considered rather than technical.
keyCharacteristics: A pale sky-to-cream hero with a single original campaign silhouette.
Three original campaign stills arranged as a native CSS scroll-driven journal: dawn departure, material study, and terminal arrival.
Oversized compressed sans typography with tight tracking and direct punctuation.
White content bands, midnight support bands, and one hard-edged clay feature surface.
Full-pill actions and filters paired with otherwise hard-edged media and panels.
No drop shadows; hierarchy comes from color, spacing, photography, and hairlines.

rules.name: Clay Allocation Rule
rules.body: Use Clay Ember for one dedicated featured system block. Do not turn it into a second CTA color or a decorative accent.

rules.name: Ink Structure Rule
rules.body: Use Deep Ink for headings, dark primary actions, icon strokes, and the footer. It is the structural color of the system.

rules.name: Pill Action Rule
rules.body: All actions, filters, option buttons, and form controls use a 1000px radius. Editorial panels and media remain square.

rules.name: Image Carries Depth Rule
rules.body: Use original campaign imagery and grayscale product photography for depth. Do not add card shadows or decorative gradients to replace real media.

dos: Do keep desktop hero statements to two intentional lines where the canvas allows.
Do use 18px body copy with generous leading so the editorial canvas breathes.
Do maintain real filter, quick-view, bag, and signup feedback states.
Do collapse the hero to a clean wordmark, image, statement, copy, and actions on mobile.
donts: Do not reintroduce lime, route blue, or a second accent color.
Do not add soft cards, drop shadows, or rounded editorial panels.
Do not use the clay surface more than once per page.
Do not present sample catalog data or checkout as a connected commerce backend.
